text:
I haven't run anything yet. Setup will store acme-dev's GitHub token on this laptop, so I need your go-ahead first. Here's the plan.

**Steps, once you say yes:**

```sh
# 1. Install the binary only
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/baney75/tentmaker/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --no-setup

# 2. Set up non-interactively (no TTY here, so --yes is required)
sudo tentmaker setup --yes --json --repo acme/webapp \
  --memory 4GiB --boost-memory 16GiB --on-battery off --no-mesh

# 3. Verify
tentmaker doctor --json
tentmaker budget --json
tentmaker repo list --json
```

**What those settings do on this 32 GB MacBook Pro:**

- **On battery:** CI uses up to 4 GiB and takes no new jobs below 40% charge.
- **Plugged in:** CI can use up to 16 GiB, but only after you've been idle for 10 minutes. Jobs stop if free disk drops below 20 GiB or if you're short on memory.
- **`--no-mesh`:** this is a single device, so it skips the Tailscale pool. Tell me if you have other machines to add.

**Questions before I run anything:**

1. **Token:** setup will use `gh auth token` from acme-dev. For GitHub runner mode, that account needs admin rights on acme/webapp, because registering runners requires Administration: write. Is acme-dev an admin of that repo? If not, I can use checks mode instead, which needs only commit-status write access.
2. **Memory:** are 4 GiB on battery and 16 GiB plugged in right for you? The default would be 8 GiB everyday, which I think is more than you want while working.
3. **Workflows:** should I check acme/webapp's workflow files and report what would need changing to run on this laptop? I'll only edit files, commit or open a PR if you say so. Migrated jobs will run on this Mac, so tell me if any deploy, publish or use secrets. Those I'd leave on GitHub-hosted runners.
4. **Scope:** is the repo private, as `gh` shows? I'll leave out `--allow-public` unless you say otherwise.

Reply with yes, plus any changes to the token, memory or workflow plan, and I'll go ahead.
